changes.detail: VM Extension Manager extension policies for the Ops Agent are now available at the folder and organization levels in Preview . Extension policies provide zonal and global Ops Agent installation, version upgrades, and configuration management. For more information, see VM Extension Manager policies for the Ops Agent . In addition, new read-only APIs are available in Preview for querying the details and status of installed VM extensions. For more information, see View extension details and status .
